summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The DAC 3D Dividend Growth ETF (DVGR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high dividend yield equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF the selects US-listed stocks of companies globally that have significantly increased their dividends for at least 10 years. Companies selected may be of any market capitalization and holdings are weighted based on fundamental criteria DVGR was launched on Dec 5, 2025 and is issued by DAC.

holdings.infoBox: DVGR is an equity ETF with a total of 39 individual holdings. The top holdings are Costco Wholesale stock at 5.01%, Oracle at 4.71%, Broadcom at 4.69%, UnitedHealth Group at 4.66%, and Microsoft at 4.05%.
